mixed_full.schedule: Same tuning prefix: 1,024,000-example warmup, constant until 90% of full corpus, cosine to zero at end
mixed_full.control: Do not automatically launch an additional full-corpus control; revisit after winner finishes.

nabla.source: official dataset_train_full; verified original cache v2; not mixed-corpus nabla
nabla.holdout: Deterministic 5% of full Standard InChIKeys from official train_full; all conformers of each key kept together. Evaluate fixed up-to-8192 keys, one conformer/key. No test references/scores accessed. These keys may have appeared in earlier research; development evidence only.
nabla.schedule: 10% linear warmup, 80% constant, 10% cosine decay, measured by training examples and identical across batches. This is a completed one-epoch tuning schedule, not the prefix of 44 epochs.
nabla.primary: Mean unaligned per-molecule RMSD over one held-out conformer per key; single-source macro equals mean
nabla.guards: Relative to LR1e-4,batch512 at same scale: bond MAE and pair-distance RMSE <=5% worse. Select lowest primary among passing runs; within1% choose lower LR then batch512 proximity. If no stable reference, use stable closest LR/batch and explicitly record.
nabla.followups: Independently tune LR/global batch for each width and each bit size:36 grid runs. Per width/bit winner, test dropout0 and0.1 against reused0.05:8 further runs. Compare independently tuned12/13-bit finalists with matched one-epoch exposure and holdout. Prefer12bits unless13bits improves RMSD >=2% and <=5% bond/pair regression. Prefer dropout0.05 unless >=1% gain and geometry guards.
nabla.pruning: Stop nonfinite training immediately; no adaptive early quality pruning because full one-epoch rank reversals are plausible. No test-driven choices.
nabla.final_refit: After tuning, full official training pool including holdout is available for fixed-budget final refit. This workflow does not auto-launch a multi-epoch nabla refit.
nabla.limits: Two scales tuned independently; no claim one-epoch ranking proves44-epoch optimality. The official ID-defined training population is preserved, not re-filtered against full-InChIKey test identities.

resources: Mixed full uses8H100. Nabla GPU jobs begin after mixed full ends, at most8 concurrent1GPU trials. CPU data preparation runs independently.
persistence: Slurm dependency chain plus checkpoints; queued work survives chat closure. Autonomous new reasoning requires an active Codex goal.
